title: Nashville Walking Tour - The Gulch by Andrew's Nashville Tours
includes: Opportunities for purchase at retail stops and coffee/food stops.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Gulch is one of Nashville's trendiest neighborhoods. It is also, in my view, a snapshot of how the city has grown and developed over the last 15 years. We'll stop at several well-known and lesser-known sites, learn about the history of the Gulch, the influences on it today, and the diverse nature of what this vibrant neighborhood offers.
